Apparently by default it's only shown on the New Tab page. My concerns with that:
1. advanced users may hide the search bar in the new tab page because they use the address bar all the time, so having 2 search boxes is "noise" for them. Do they lose immediate access to the button?
2. doesn't solve the concern with search being unreachable when I'm in a tab with a loaded page. In that case we theorized it's more likely for the user to type google.com in the address bar and do an organic search, because there is no persistent indication they can search in the address bar.
